claim: The character's physical state — tired, bleeding, freezing — which has to persist across shots or continuity collapses the moment he heals between cuts. A director sets it once at the scene level so every generation of that character carries the same damage.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: tired, eye bags, half-closed eyes, exhausted
injured, bandaged arm, bruised cheek, scrapes
bleeding, blood on face, cut on cheek
sick, pale skin, feverish blush, sweat on forehead
soaking wet, wet hair, dripping water
shivering, visible breath, red nose, cold
heavy sweat, flushed face, sweat drops, panting
drunk, flushed cheeks, unfocused eyes, swaying
possessed, glowing eyes, vacant stare, shadowed face

look_at: tired/injured/bleeding/soaked/drunk/possessed all visibly land; ill is weak.
